layouts.name: Dixon Kart Circuit
layouts.description: The association lists Kinsmen Kart Club at Dixon. The independently visible paved full circuit retains the northeastern bulb, central hairpin and two western hairpins. The small diagonal infield connector, pit access and neighboring dirt speedway are excluded. Fine corner alignment and driving direction remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 645.9 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
